nguon: 💬 Giao tiếp · Chuyện vặt hằng ngày · bài tự soạn
L: A
Morning, Dan! Is it just me, or is it freezing today?
B
It's not just you. The radio says it'll drop to five degrees.
A
Ugh, I left my scarf at home. I'm gonna turn into an ice cube.
B
Here, take mine. I've got a spare one in my bag.
A
Are you sure? That's really kind of you.
B
No worries. By the way, did you hear it's gonna rain this weekend?
A
Again? It's been pouring all week. My shoes are still wet.
B
Same here. I'm so sick of this weather. Oh, here comes the bus!
A
Finally! Thanks for the scarf, Dan. I'll give it back tomorrow.
B
No rush. Stay warm and hang in there!

exq.q: What did Linh forget at home?
exq.why: “I left my scarf at home” = để quên khăn quàng ở nhà.

exq.q: What will the weather be like this weekend?
exq.why: “it's gonna rain this weekend” = cuối tuần sắp mưa.
“take mine. I've got a spare one” = cho mượn khăn dự phòng.

exq.q: What does Linh promise to do tomorrow?
exq.why: “I'll give it back tomorrow” = mai sẽ trả khăn.
